ar: إذا فرض الله جل وعلا علينا الجهاد
en: If Allah, Glorified and Exalted, ordains jihad for us,
then we shall strive until we attain our goal

ar: أو نلقى ملاقى حمزة بن عبد المطلب
en: or meet the fate of Hamza ibn ‘Abd al-Muttalib.
And then tell me, by your Lord:
what of these calls to spread despair, weaken resolve, and sink into degradation?
Tell me, by your Lord—

ar: وهذا الكلام الأصل يبقى فينا على ذكر
en: and let this truth remain firmly etched in our hearts,

ar: لا يغيبن عن بالنا طرفة عين ولا أقل من ذلك
en: never absent from our minds, not even for a moment—
why is Gaza under siege,
and why is its project of jihad being relentlessly pursued and targeted?
If Gaza, dear brothers,

ar: جاءت بمشروع سياسي يلتقي مع العدو على قاعدة من التنسيق
en: had embraced a political project that aligned with the enemy on the basis of coordination,
would Gaza have been besieged?
By Allah, no!
If Gaza, dear brothers,

ar: وضعت سلاحها وصارت ألعوبة بيد المحتل من أجل لعاعة الدنيا
en: had laid down its arms and become a plaything in the hands of the occupier in exchange for some paltry worldly gain,
would Gaza have been besieged?
By Allah, no!
If Gaza had betrayed its generation

ar: وتركت ألعوبة بيد شذاذ الآفاق من صناع التفاهة
en: and allowed itself to become a plaything in the hands of the rabble from every corner of the earth—those who manufacture triviality—

ar: بعيداً عن مراكز التحفيظ ومعسكرات التدريب
en: instead of remaining committed to Qur’an memorization centers and training camps,
would Gaza have been besieged?
By Allah, no!

ar: نحن أيها المباركون لا نملك خياراً إلا الاستمرار
en: We, dear brothers, have no choice but to persevere—
and to persevere with strength.
